project_identity.name: MediPriority AI
project_identity.tagline: OPD Triage Assistant for Government Hospitals
project_identity.core_mission: Enable triage nurses to assess emergency & OPD patients in under 60 seconds, identify Level 1-5 urgency, recommend optimal departments, trigger red-flag safety rules, and minimize avoidable ED mortality.

components: Vitals Input with Auto-Range Alerts (BP, HR, SpO2, Temp, RR, GCS)
Real-Time AI Preview & Safety Rule Trigger

key_features_and_views.title: AI Triage Recommendation & Explanation

Department Allocation (e.g., Cardiology, Resuscitation Bay, General Medicine)

Model Performance & Clinical Safety Dashboard

key_features_and_views.title: Historical Triage & Patient Search
components: Search by Patient ID / Name / Mobile
Filter by Date / Severity Level / Attending Nurse

test_id_conventions.mandatory_rule: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a full-stack MediPriority AI application using Python FastAPI backend for AI triage scoring, rule engine, and queue simulation, with React frontend.

Follow the clean hospital command center layout with a dark navy sidebar (#0F172A), crisp top header with staff profile & active shift stats, and clean white background (#F8FAFC) for primary workspace.

Ensure triage Level 1 to 5 badges are highly visible and follow clinical color coding (Red, Orange, Amber, Teal, Green). Never rely solely on color—always display clear text labels like 'Level 1: Resuscitation (Immediate)'.
Integrate interactive sample profiles for rapid testing in the intake form (e.g., Severe Acute Chest Pain, High Fever Child, Chronic Knee Pain) so users can experience 60-second triage in one click.
Implement the full Analytics Dashboard with 5x5 Confusion Matrix, Emergency Recall Score (e.g. 99.4%), Asymmetric Loss metric, and Wait-Time Simulation comparing FCFS vs AI Priority Queue.
Use data-testid attributes on all buttons, forms, badges, table cells, tabs, and key metrics as outlined in test_id_conventions.
